title: Dependency injection in one screen
rememberThis: Register in builder.Services; resolve via constructor injection — IServiceCollection registers, IServiceProvider resolves.
Three lifetimes: singleton (app), scoped (per request), transient (per resolution). DbContext is always scoped.
Captive dependency: singleton holding scoped = scoped lives forever. ValidateOnBuild + ValidateScopes in CI.
IServiceScopeFactory for BackgroundService — CreateScope per work item, not per service lifetime.
Keyed DI (.NET 8+): AddKeyedScoped + [FromKeyedServices("key")] for multiple implementations.
bullets: Longer lifetime cannot depend on shorter: singleton → singleton only; scoped → singleton or scoped.
ValidateOnBuild validates the entire graph at startup — enable in every CI pipeline.
TryAdd* for library defaults; app uses Add* to override. Scrutor for decorator pattern.
Minimal API handlers inject services as parameters — same request scope as controllers.
IEndpointFilter on MapGroup for per-route validation/auth without global middleware.
dotnet-counters active-db-contexts ≈ concurrent requests — stuck at 1 = captive DbContext.
NestJS Scope.REQUEST = scoped; Express has no container — manual wiring or awilix.
